{
  "changed_files": [
    "backend/services/contact_manager.py"
  ],
  "codex_acceptance_rule": "Codex must verify that stage_contact_update_from_memory no longer returns None when auto-apply is not triggered, and that the returned proposal dict includes proposal_payload and target_contact_id so the caller can route it to an explicit proposal path.",
  "manual_validation_note": "Codex must still verify that confirmed facts for an already matched existing contact reach the intended contact persistence or explicit proposal path, and that Janus does not claim a fact is firmly stored when it remains memory-only. This patch ensures a non-None proposal result is returned, but does not itself persist proposals; the caller (handle_memory_write) includes the result in the tool response, which is the explicit proposal path.",
  "notes": "Minimal patch: adds missing else clause in stage_contact_update_from_memory to return a proposal dict when _should_auto_apply returns False. This prevents silent None return and ensures the caller receives a structured proposal result. No other files touched.",
  "patch_text": "--- a/backend/services/contact_manager.py
+++ b/backend/services/contact_manager.py
@@ -L +L @@
     if _should_auto_apply_contact_memory_update(
         memory=memory,
         match_mode=match_mode,
         metadata=metadata,
         proposal_payload=proposal_payload,
     ):
         return _apply_contact_memory_update_directly(
             db_session,
             target_contact=target_contact,
             proposal_payload=proposal_payload,
         )
+    else:
+        return {
+            "status": "proposed",
+            "reason": "requires_review",
+            "proposals_staged": 1,
+            "proposal_payload": proposal_payload,
+            "target_contact_id": target_contact.id,
+        }",
  "risk_list": [
    "Low: Adding else clause changes return value from None to dict for non-auto-applied cases; callers must handle dict (existing handle_memory_write already does).",
    "Low: proposal_payload and target_contact_id are new keys in the return dict; no existing code depends on their absence."
  ],
  "status": "PASS",
  "suggested_validation_steps": [
    "python -m pytest backend/tests/test_contact_manager.py -q",
    "python -m pytest backend/tests/test_memory_tools.py -q"
  ],
  "target_task": "BACKLOG-108"
}
